understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level and run to be won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, with coordinates represented in pixel/grid positions. Adjacent pushable blocks could be moved along with a piece, while walls and boundaries could block movement. Movement-blocked indicators were only hints and actions sometimes had to be tested. CLICK switched control between selectable pieces using their displayed coordinates, allowing each piece to be positioned independently.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level and run to be won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, with coordinates represented in pixel/grid positions. Adjacent pushable blocks could be moved along with a piece, while walls and boundaries could block movement. Movement-blocked indicators were only hints and actions sometimes had to be tested. CLICK switched control between selectable pieces using their displayed coordinates, allowing each piece to be positioned independently.
